notes.title: 🩸 Major Update
notes.content:
[h3]⚙️ Optimization[/h3][p]The project has become significantly lighter on system load.
Lighting, shadow calculations, draw distance, texture streaming, and other systems have been reworked.
[b]Performance has increased by 1.5–2×[/b] compared to the previous version.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]📖 Tutorial[/h3][p]A short comic has been added during the loading screen.
It helps new players get into the core of the game more smoothly.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]📊 Progress[/h3][p]The HUD now shows:[/p][list][*][p]Number of totems collected,[/p][/*][*][p]Number of deaths,[/p][/*][*][p]Completion timer.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]For speedrunners:[/b]
Start and finish points are now fixed — the same for everyone.
You can now compare results fairly.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]⚽ New Quest[/h3][p][b]The Mystery of the Ball.[/b]
It helps pass the time while waiting —
but those who go all the way may unlock something unexpected.
Though it might raise even more questions.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🌀 New Area[/h3][p]Take part in a hunt, touched by an eastern breeze.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🛠 Minor Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Catapult mechanics improved,[/p][/*][*][p]Highlighting added to interactive elements,[/p][/*][*][p]Visual cues and hints slightly clarified.[/p][/*][/list]
